newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Jan-Feb non-CIS oil, product exports jump.
newsitem.headline: Russian Jan-Feb non-CIS oil, product exports jump.

text.p: Russian oil exports outside the Commonwealth of Independent States rose nine percent to 16.95 million tonnes, or 2.03 million barrels per day, in the first two months of 1997, the State Statistics Committee said Monday.

The committee, quoted by Interfax news agency, said oil product exports soared 50 percent to 8.22 million tonnes (0.99 million bpd) in January-February from 5.48 million (0.66 million bpd) over the same period last year.
Non-CIS natural gas exports rose one percent to 23.05 billion cubic metres (bcm) in the first two months against 22.75 bcm a year ago, the committee said.
